intro: If you're on a tight budget but still want to stay in Khao Takiab and walk to the beach, Takiab Beach Resort is a pick plenty of travellers come back to · it's a small budget 3-star hotel of roughly 18–27 rooms, just a few minutes' walk from Khao Takiab Beach and close to Cicada Market and the beachfront seafood strip · there's an outdoor pool and a separate kids' pool, rooms have balconies (many overlooking the pool), and parking is free · from approx. ฿1,200/night · scored 8.1 from 39 reviews — not a luxury stay, but solid value if your priority is being near the beach.

body.html: Takiab Beach Resort sits in the Khao Takiab area of Nong Kae, at the southern end of Hua Hin's beach · its main draw is a location within a few minutes' walk of Khao Takiab Beach (about 300 metres) and close to Cicada Market, the Hua Hin floating market, and the seafood restaurants and massage shops that line the Khao Takiab strip · it's a small, family-run place rather than a big resort, and the atmosphere is noticeably quieter than central Hua Hin · a good fit if you want a near-the-beach base on a budget.

Rooms come with air conditioning, a fridge, a TV and a private balcony, with many looking out over the pool · front-facing rooms tend to have the larger balconies · sizes are fine for a couple or a small family, the beds are comfortable, and guests single out the mattresses for praise · what you should understand is that this is an older building — some areas like flooring, balcony railings and woodwork look dated, and reviews mention weak shower water pressure in some rooms plus Wi-Fi that can be patchy · for this price that's acceptable, but worth knowing up front.
"Really cheap, just a few minutes' walk to Khao Takiab Beach, friendly smiling staff, clean room with a comfy bed, and there's even a pool for the kids — great value for what we paid."

The pool is a decently sized outdoor pool with a separate kids' pool, which makes it handy for families travelling with children · the area around it isn't large but it's quiet and pleasant to sit by · on food, understand that the resort serves breakfast only — there's no all-day restaurant, and breakfast is a small buffet charged separately from the room · the upside is that you're only steps from the seafood places, made-to-order eateries and cafés along Khao Takiab beach, so you don't need to rely on the hotel kitchen.

The thing reviews praise most is the friendly, helpful staff · being family-run, many guests say they were looked after more warmly than they expected at this price · room cleanliness also earns praise, with daily housekeeping · free on-site parking is a plus for anyone driving themselves · the trade-off is limited facilities in keeping with a budget property — no gym, spa or big-resort services.

The location is both a strength and something to understand · Khao Takiab is quiet and close to the beach and Cicada Market, but it's about a 10–15 minute drive from central Hua Hin and the night market · if you want to head into town every evening you'll need a taxi or your own car · Khao Takiab temple and its monkey hill are very close, an easy walk or short ride away · if your plan is to relax around Khao Takiab beach, eat seafood and browse Cicada Market on weekends, this location works well and saves you money on transport.

Honestly, Takiab Beach Resort is a strong fit for budget travellers, couples and small families who value a near-the-beach location over luxury · regular-season rates start around ฿1,200–1,800/night for a standard room · over long weekends and high season prices rise and rooms fill fast because there are so few of them · if you expect a brand-new property, full facilities or a true beachfront, this isn't it · but if you want a Khao Takiab base within walking distance of the beach at a price you can actually afford, this is a value pick many guests return to.

A tip from following the reviews here: ask for a front-facing room with the larger balcony and a pool view, and check with the property about its most recently updated rooms if you're worried about wear · in the evening, walk out for seafood and a foot massage along the Khao Takiab strip for good prices · on weekends Cicada Market is close enough to walk to · if you're travelling with young children the kids' pool is a real plus, but if you need every meal on site, pick somewhere else — this place only does breakfast.

honestSummary: Takiab Beach Resort sells a Khao Takiab location within walking distance of the beach and Cicada Market at a budget price · there's a pool and a kids' pool, the staff are good and rooms are clean and good value · but understand it's an older building with limited facilities, breakfast only, and it isn't a true beachfront.
honestChecks: If you expect a brand-new property with full facilities — this is a budget stay in an older building with no gym or spa → choose a higher-tier resort in Khao Takiab instead.
If you want every meal on site — this place serves breakfast only, with no all-day restaurant → walk out to the nearby seafood restaurants along Khao Takiab beach instead.
If you want to walk into town and the night market every evening — Khao Takiab is about a 10–15 minute drive from the centre → choose central Hua Hin instead.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Takiab Beach Resort Hua Hin

faq.q: Where is Takiab Beach Resort and can you walk to the beach?
faq.a: It's in the Khao Takiab area of Nong Kae, at the southern end of Hua Hin's beach · it's about a 3–5 minute walk (roughly 300 metres) to Khao Takiab Beach · close to Cicada Market, the Hua Hin floating market and the beachfront seafood strip · it's about a 10–15 minute drive from central Hua Hin and the night market.

faq.q: What does Takiab Beach Resort cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Regular-season rates start around ฿1,200/night for a Standard Room · there are also Superior, Deluxe and Family rooms at slightly higher prices · rooms have air conditioning, a fridge, a TV and a balcony · long-weekend and high-season prices rise quickly and rooms fill fast since there are so few — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is there a pool, and is it good for families with children?
faq.a: Yes · Takiab Beach Resort has an outdoor swimming pool and a separate kids' pool, which suits families travelling with children · the Family Room is also roomier for families · it's a nice perk that isn't easy to find at this budget level.

faq.q: Who is Takiab Beach Resort best for?
faq.a: It's best for budget travellers, couples and small families who value a near-the-beach location over luxury · ideal for anyone who wants to stay in Khao Takiab, eat seafood and browse Cicada Market at an affordable price · it's not for those expecting a brand-new property, full facilities or a true beachfront.

There's only a small buffet breakfast (charged separately from the room), with no all-day restaurant · but you're just steps from seafood places, made-to-order eateries and cafés along Khao Takiab beach — convenient and well priced.

It's a budget stay in an older building · reviews mention some dated areas (floors, railings, woodwork), patchy Wi-Fi at times and weak shower pressure in some rooms — acceptable at this price but worth knowing · ask for a front-facing room with a larger balcony and pool view, and check for the most recently updated rooms when booking.
